_meta.note: DL-0828 Principal Grok bulk T8 ME House. Score the named House office only. Affiliated legislature.maine.gov / maine.gov/housedems / campaign sites + 2024 DNC/RNC platform (data/party-platforms.json state maps). Individual overrides: Reagan Paul campaign About/Issues (life, school choice, CRT, voter ID/paper ballots, 2A/red-flag); Faircloth campaign + House Dems (choice, LGBTQ ally, Theocrats book, immigrants/MMC); Doudera House Dems + LD 759 sponsor (gun-safety caucus / assault-weapon retailer letters). Independent Pluecker: no R/D platform inherit; official bios have no rubric issue cells — left blank. Blank > wrong. No invented roll calls. FEC/AIPAC/PAC cells left blank (search not run). refuse_state_overreach not scored (local-only). RNC state-map gaps (election 0/2 except Paul individual, border 0, christian_liberty 4, industry_capture) left blank. reset_unspecified=false.
